messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway-prod (edge-proxy) — sustained spike for ~12m, error rate peaked at ~18%. Metric: gateway.5xx_rate. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/alerts/5419998888
maria: paging @ajay (oncall) and @ben-infra, I'm oncall for infra this shift. starting triage. :rotating_light:
ajay: joining now, setting up zoom and tracing. I see surge dominated by 503/504 with request paths /v1/infer and /v1/embeddings. Correlates with a config push ~3m ago.
ben: I deployed a route weight change 3m ago to shift traffic to pool-b (weight +40%). deployed via `kubectl apply -f envoy-route-weights.yaml`. If that's the cause I can revert immediately.
sophie: copying envoy stats snippets here — looks bad: `cluster.inference_pool_b.upstream_rq_503: 1432`, `cluster.inference_pool_b.upstream_rq_504: 321`, circuit_breakers show `cx_overflow` increments. Retry amplification pattern present (retries * fail->5xx).
maria: quick mitigation idea: disable retries on the inference route to stop amplification and reduce load. anyone object?
ajay: agree. quick patch: create a configmap patch to set `retry_policy: NONE` for route `/v1/infer` and apply. Example patch below:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: envoy-route-patch
data:
  patch.yaml: |-
    - match: /v1/infer
      route:
        retry_policy: NONE
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f envoy-route-patch.yaml
```
ben: reverting weight change now to move traffic off pool-b: `kubectl -n infra patch configmap envoy-routes --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/weights","value":"{\"pool-a\":100,\"pool-b\":0}"}]'` — patching.
deploy-bot: configmap update 5419998888 applied by ben (envoy-routes) :white_check_mark:
maria: after disabling retries and reverting weight, 5xx rate decreased from ~18% to ~3% within 2 minutes. Keep monitoring.
sophie: digging into pool-b nodes — upstream logs show connection timeouts and increased latency, suggesting overload on that pool rather than downstream bug. Also saw `max_connections` incorrectly set to a very high value for pool-b in generated config, leading to head-of-line resource saturation.
ajay: additional mitigations executed: 1) disabled retries on route 2) reverted weight to pool-a 3) scaled pool-b replica count +3 to give headroom 4) applied temporary CB tweaks to reduce max connections to pool-b to limit bleed.
ben: discovered automation bug in weight-generator that produced an invalid `max_connections: 0` override in some cases during rollout. Will open a bug.
maria: customer impact: affecting ~7 customers with intermittent 5xx on inference API, no major SSO or billing customers impacted per initial mapping. Tagging severity: Sev2. Support notified.
ajay: filing incident ticket INC-2026-04123 with timeline and initial mitigation notes: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-04123
sophie: I'll prepare query and attach sample traces/logs for support. Can someone post the short script we used to check envoy stats?
ben: `kubectl -n infra exec -c admin envoy-control-0 -- curl -s http://localhost:9901/stats | egrep "upstream_rq_5|cx_overflow"` — that helped us see immediate counters.
maria: handoff note: I'll monitor for another 30m then hand to next oncall (ajay) for follow-up and postmortem. Root ts: 5419998888, mitigated captured at: 5419999010. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident updated — mitigated state set, PagerDuty incident updated accordingly. :phone:
ben: I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups: create pre-deploy lint for weight-generator, add automated check for generated CB/max_connections sanity, and add a retry-amplification alert rule.
ajay: assigned follow-ups and will add a runbook blurb for disabling retries in emergency for inference route.
maria: thanks everyone for quick coordination. We'll post RCA and action items to #postmortems and loop in product for customer comms.
